bio: The Ivy Royal Windsor Brasserie is part of The Ivy Collection, which remains true to the values of the original Ivy restaurant, famous for its celebrity clientele and superior dining experience. Interiors feature sumptuous Art-Deco detail, marble floors and striking burnt orange banquettes.  Afternoon Tea at The Ivy is a relaxed experience, presented on a three-tier stand featuring freshly baked fruit scones, finger sandwiches, sweet delights and a choice of teas or coffee. For an extra-special occasion, make it a day to remember by adding a glass of Champagne.  The Ivy Royal Windsor Brasserie overlooks Windsor Castle, in the heart of the historic town.  Afternoon Tea is served every day from 3pm to 4.45pm and costs £29.95 per person, or £39.95 with a glass of Champagne.
